source: Current owner message in this task chat
quote: Для стратега. Если ты одну задачу на согласование отправил. Формируй следуюшие в холостую не работай. Я могу несколько задач сразу согласовать.
instruction: An existing task proposal awaiting approval is not a reason for strategist idle. Prepare next useful distinct proposals in the existing backlog, prioritized with bounds, user effect, before/after, size, dependencies, acceptance and score unknown/neutral when appropriate; owner may approve several in one decision. Preserve existing proposals, do not duplicate or invent low-value work. Start approval and exact-package publication remain separate gates; other role claims and currently approved execution have priority.
supersedes: Earlier wait solely because one suitable proposal already exists; requirement for one recommended task now means ordered recommendations can include multiple independently reviewable tasks.
not_authorized: Changing rating/score weights or inflating scores
applies_to: Strategist process; automation schedule/prompt not changed
